exposure: Gestational weight gain rate (GWGR) in the second and third trimesters (insufficient, normal, excessive)
Pre-pregnancy body mass index (BMI) (low, normal, high subgroups)
finding: Excessive gestational weight gain rate in the second and third trimesters was associated with severe adverse birth outcomes, especially among women with high pre-pregnancy BMI, while insufficient GWGR was associated with decreased risk of some pregnancy complications like hyperlipidemia but increased risk of GDM.
mod_finding: Excessive gestational weight gain rate in the second and third trimesters was associated with an increased risk of caesarean section, particularly in the high pre-pregnancy BMI subgroup.
cross-section timing: Data was collected between March 2018 and December 2018.
